title: Concept: HashiCorp Nomad UI disclosed
description: The Nomad UI is served at this endpoint, so the orchestrator console with its job, allocation and client inventory is reachable.
applicability: Responses served by a Nomad server with the UI enabled.
risk: The console names the workloads and their client nodes, and can stop or resubmit jobs where the ACL policy allows it; MEDIUM because the page alone does not prove a change is accepted.
